sources.summary: We’re reimagining Microsoft Copilot to enable work as it evolves and to help expand what every individual and every organization can accomplish in the flow of human ambition. Today we’re introducing the new Copilot to connect the tools people rely on with the next generation of capabilities they’ll need to build, customize and scale AI... The post Introducing the new Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot appeared first on The Official Microsoft Blog .
sources.summary_zh: 我們正在重新構想 微軟 Copilot，以順應工作的演變，並幫助拓展每個人和每個組織在人類雄心壯志的浪潮中所能成就的事業。今天，我們推出全新的 Copilot，將人們賴以使用的工具與他們建構、客製化和擴展 AI 所需的新一代功能連結起來... 這篇文章 Introducing the new Copilot with Home, Code and Autopilot 最初發布於 The Official 微軟 Blog。
